services.desc: Raise a glass and help create more opportunities for kids to experience camp! Join YMCA Camp Kern on February 6 from 7-10 p.m. for an evening featuring local beer and wine, food, and live bluegrass music by Slippery Creek. Non-alcoholic beverages will also be available.
